hypothesis: The bonus number from the immediately preceding draw may carry cutoff-safe information about main-number inclusion in the next draw; a smoothed bonus-conditioned transition score may improve a deterministic three-line disjoint portfolio over the exact union18 random null.
source_data_hash_scope_note: Count non-empty CSV draw records, preserve internal and trailing blank lines in the frozen prefix, and stop before any next non-empty record after round 1249.
training_cutoff_rule: For target t, use only main draws 1..t-1 and transition examples u=2..t-1 where the feature is bonus(u-1) and the outcome is main(u). The target feature is bonus(t-1). Update counts with main(t) only after scoring target t.

signal.feature: Immediately preceding draw's bonus number, in the range 1..45.
signal.outcome: The six main numbers in the following draw.
signal.conditional_sample: For each target t, count prior transitions bonus(u-1)=bonus(t-1) -> main(u) for u=2..t-1.
signal.global_shrinkage: Use main-number inclusion frequency over draws 1..t-1 as the prior mean.

portfolio.line_assignment: Deterministic rank interleaving: line 1 uses ranks 1,4,7,10,13,16; line 2 uses ranks 2,5,8,11,14,17; line 3 uses ranks 3,6,9,12,15,18.
portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.

random_comparator.method: For each target, apply a uniformly sampled permutation of labels 1..45 jointly to the three model lines. This preserves three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null; sample overlapping contiguous blocks while preserving the fixed final remainder-block length.

prospective_confirmation.readiness_rule: Even if the historical gate passes, do not create STRICT_PASS_READY or release purchase lines until the policy owner formally predeclares the prospective minimum target count and completion rule.

promotion_rule: Evaluate this single preregistered axis once. No variants, threshold changes, or parameter search after observing results. Historical strict failure remains failure. Historical pass alone cannot create purchase readiness because prospective confirmation is required and currently unspecified.
